page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes on this page. The printed line-end ornaments on the right are not text. Left of the column is the edge of the neighbouring page, which is excluded. Signature "H 3" at the foot, right.

main_text.p: orum detruncationem, gladio Petri dextras omnium armavit Antistitum: quando sanctæ memoriæ Papa Bonifacius, piissimorum Imperatorum devotione catholicâ gaudebat, & contra inimicos gratiæ Dei, non solum apostolicis, sed etiam regiis utebatur edictis: & quandoidem, cùm esset doctissimus, adversus libros tamen Pelagianorum, B. Augustini Episcopi responsa poscebat. Unde & venerabilis memoriæ Pontifex Cælestinus, cui, ad Catholicæ Ecclesiæ præsidium, multa Dominus gratiæ suæ dona largitus est; sciens, damnatis non examē judicii, sed solum pœna remedium, esse præstandum; Cælestium, quasi non discusso negotio audientiam postulantem, (NB. modestiam Cælestini, Pontificis Rom. suprà prædicatam à Grotio) totius Italiæ finibus jussit extrudi. adeò & præcessorum suorum statuta, & decreta synodalia, inviolabiliter servanda censebat: ut, quod semel meruerat abscindi, nequaquam admitteret retractari. Nec vero segniore curâ, ab hoc eodem morbo Britannias liberavit: quando quosdam inimicos Gratiæ, solum suæ originis occupantes, etiam ab illo secreto exclusit Oceani; & ordinato Scotis Epi-

page.notes: The printed line-end ornaments on the right (repeated "»" marks) are not transcribed. The page number is printed at the top centre as "117". No running head, catchword or heading is printed. The text runs on past the foot of the page ("Epi-"), so the next page continues it. "examē" is printed with a macron over the e and is copied as printed.
